text: ゲームで　ためた　コインは　そとの　こうかんじょで　すきな　けいひんと　かえてね！

structure.jp: ゲームで　ためた　コインは
structure.en: the coins you saved up in the games

structure.jp: そとの　こうかんじょで
すきな　けいひんと

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ゲームで　ためた　コイン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb, placed right before a thing, tells you which thing. ゲームで　ためた　コイン = 'the coins you saved up in the games'.

patterns.name: 〜とかえる
patterns.span: けいひんと　かえて
patterns.explanation: With かえる, と shows the thing you get in exchange. けいひんと　かえて = 'swap them for prizes'.

patterns.name: 〜てください
patterns.explanation: A て-form on its own is a casual request, ください being left off, and ね makes it friendly. かえてね = 'exchange them, okay?'
